title: pingdotgg/t3code
lede: T3 Code is an open-source control plane for coding agents: it runs Claude Code, Codex and others on your own machine and puts them behind one interface you can use from desktop, web or phone.

points: It drives agents you are already signed in to, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and any ACP agent, and resells no tokens.
Threads can switch models midway, and one agent can hand a task to another.
A single server backs every client, with iOS and Android apps, and remote access over the local network, Tailscale or T3 Connect.
Each thread can work in its own git worktree, with buttons to review the diff, commit, push and open a pull request.
MIT licensed; the team says it wants users able to fork it if the project goes the wrong way.
